findings.reason: the plan's "widens that fallback by exactly the dotted and hyphenated continuations … and by nothing else" is false as written, so it must either keep the `[1-9]` leading-digit frame for this fallback or add `s0` to the pinned test.
findings.text: composing the undeclared-plan fallback from the shared number core `\d+(?:[.-]\d+)*` widens `_NUMBERED_SECTION_ID` (`s[1-9][0-9]*`) to also admit `s0`/`s00`/`s01`, not only the dotted and hyphenated continuations the plan names, and the pinned synthetic test lists only s5, s5.1, s5-1, 5, §5 and decisions

findings.reason: the section's "+1 public definition" accounting is short by the accessor the composer needs, or the design must state that `write_review_sidecar` computes the mapping itself from the document rather than the composer writing it.
findings.text: the composer that must write the `section_digests` mapping into the review sidecar lives in `reckon/crew/recovery.py` (it calls `plan_review.write_review_sidecar` at recovery.py:587, passing `plan_review.plan_fingerprint(document)`), yet §16 declares `_section_digests` module-private on `plan_review.py` and states the public `plan_fingerprint` signature does not widen, so the mapping has no public path across the module boundary

findings.reason: derivation and validity are genuinely different questions, the plan states the split explicitly, and co-locating the derivation with the raw-text parser that applies it is defensible.
findings.text: the plan adds `plan_headings` and the machinery-element predicate as public names on `reckon/_plan_html.py` while `reckon/_schema.py` (already imported by `_plan_html.py`) owns the sibling section-identity validity vocabulary (`is_section_identity`, `_RESOURCE_SEGMENT_RE`)

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §17 keeps one private raw-text read and projects `plan_headings` and `structured_section_spans` from it, and §16 hides the digest and the coverage question behind private helpers rather than spreading wrappers over them.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — §17 consolidates the heading walks and card recognisers onto the existing `_StructuredSectionSpanParser` and names the owners it moves (`section_record_id`, `landed_section_ids`) rather than forking them; §16 consumes them.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 1478, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §16 accounts a single added public definition (`strip_tags`) but requires the recovery composer to emit the section-digest mapping with no public accessor to obtain it.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan cites the machinery it extends, but its shared-number-core reuse does not fit every frame it is composed into, widening one beyond what the plan states.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — `strip_tags` adds entity decoding and skip-tag interior removal that `_TAG_RE` alone lacks, and §17 re-homes `landed_section_ids` and the heading helpers rather than layering over them.
